title: Chic 1BR|Central Location|Rooftop|Gym|Free Parking
description:
Our thoughtfully and professionally designed 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo delivers an authentic Nashville experience. It comfortably accommodates up to 5 guests with a king bed in the bedroom, a queen sofa sleeper, and a custom bed. Located just 0.8 miles from Downtown Broadway, you’re only a 5-minute drive or an easy walk to iconic live music venues, world-class dining, and entertainment,. Enjoy access to a rooftop deck with skyline views, perfect for experiencing the heart of Music City.

The space
• Open-concept entry with the kitchen flowing directly into the living room.
• Bunk bed is immediately to the left as you enter.
• Washer and dryer conveniently located underneath the bunk bed.
• Living room with a queen pullout sofa for additional sleeping space.
• Private bedroom with a king bed for a comfortable night’s rest.
• Small balcony off of the living room. 
• Access to rooftop space and gym.
• Access to free parking in the garage for up to two cars.

Guest access
Our building is secure, with controlled access to the building, common areas, fitness center, and condo through the Point Central system. Additionally, on-site security is provided at night and on weekends.
